concentration_robustness: Removal of best five events must retain positive cumulative attribution return
cost_robustness: 2x costs must retain positive cumulative return
diagnostic_catastrophe: Contract rule; no rescue or tuning
family_incremental: Both discovery and matched validation: MaxDD and CVaR strictly lower, retain at least 80% matched family-OFF CAGR
model_risk: Report decile realized worst-decile loss vs entry conservative tail; never recalibrate
post_hoc_robustness: Apply the identical predeclared Native-relative validation comparison to aggregate 2024-2026 diagnostic; this remains post-hoc and cannot rescue a validation failure
ranking_incremental: Both discovery and matched validation: CAGR and Sharpe strictly higher, MaxDD no higher than same RP/security/family R0
risk_engine_required: Matched R0 must pass predeclared Native-relative validation; predictive ranking cannot rescue failed risk engine
